name: axHub web help
description: Help mode entries for axHub web: approvals (who asked, Approve now / Deny / details), the request page, the log, Go pass, users, account, handoff and the hub pages, plus screen intros. Hand-written.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Approvals
entries.text: Everything waiting on you: held calls counting down (they run by themselves unless you Deny) and straight approvals (they only run if you Approve).
entries.more: Each row says who asked (Claude.ai, Claude Code, headless build, console, agent), what it wants to do and why. Deny drops it for good; Approve now runs it at once; Shelve pauses a countdown until you make up your mind.
entries.tryIt: Tap a row's caret to see the exact code before you decide.

entries.title: Hub
entries.text: Your hub at a glance: services, jobs, devices and what's connected.

entries.title: Request
entries.text: One call in full: the reason, the exact code, who asked, the tool and its risk, the timeline and the result.

entries.title: Go pass
entries.text: Lets a Claude session that can't reach the hub work anyway, for the hours you pick. When it ends, they stop.
entries.tryIt: Pick the hours, add a note, tap Go.

entries.title: Approvals log
entries.text: Every call the hub ever held or asked about: decided, denied, timed out — with who asked and what ran.

entries.title: Apps
entries.text: Your apps on the hub, each with its page.

entries.title: Users
entries.text: Who can sign in to the hub, their role and their permissions.

entries.title: Handoff
entries.text: Hands a job to another Claude account with everything it needs, and shows the runs.

entries.title: Handoff run

entries.title: Assets

steps.say: Everything waiting on you. Held calls count down and run by themselves unless you Deny them.
Each row says who asked and what it wants. The caret opens the exact code in place.
Deny drops it for good. Approve now runs it right away. That's it — you're the boss.
Every call the hub ever held or asked about, newest first.
Filter by source or tool, tap a row for the full request.
When a Claude session can't reach the hub, it stops and asks for a go. This is where you give one.
Pick the hours, tap Go. When it runs out, the sessions stop again.
Who can sign in, their role and what they may do.
Tap a user to change their role, permissions or set a temporary password.
